content: Native CSS card-grid pattern: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)) with align-items: stretch gives a responsive card grid with equal-height rows, no media queries needed. Card variants achieved via a modifier class exposing CSS custom properties (color/spacing/radius overrides) layered on a shared base card class, avoiding specificity fights. Grid preferred over Flexbox when equal-height rows / precise column control matter; Flexbox fine for single-row wrapping toolbars (e.g. tab nav).
